description: Cross-dataset object-scale distribution and within-dataset COCO AP_S comparison

provenance.dataset_1_protocol: test split, 220 images; KaryoFlow clean random-coupling 3-seed mean, other detectors seed 42
provenance.dataset_2_protocol: validation split, 500 images; KaryoFlow three-seed mean, other detectors unified checkpoint-linked re-evaluation

evidence_boundary: AP_S values are compared only within each dataset. Dataset 1 and Dataset 2 use different splits, and non-KaryoFlow comparators are single-seed checkpoints, so raw cross-dataset AP_S levels and between-method variance are not interpreted as paired differences.
